description: This file declares the interface IControllerFactory for creating IPC controller objects within the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace. It includes a factory method to create instances and a method to create a protobuf RpcController. The file is part of the IPC component of the Rialto project, providing an abstract factory interface for IPC controllers.

classes.name: IControllerFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating IPC controller objects, providing a static factory method and a virtual method to create RpcController instances.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of IControllerFactory.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a protobuf RpcController object.
